import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Select features based on effect size
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        # Compute mean difference by outcome
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 0, i])
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y == 1, i])
        effect_size = abs(y1_mean - y0_mean)
        effect_sizes.append((effect_size, fid))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features for drivers (limit to 4 as per checker)
    drivers = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:4]]
    
    # Select features for logistic regression (columns) - limit to 8
    columns = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:8]]
    
    # Check for interactions between top features
    products = []
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:4]]
    for i, a in enumerate(top_features):
        for b in top_features[i+1:]:
            if a != b:
                products.append((a, b))
    
    # Weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, (effect_size, fid) in enumerate(effect_sizes[:4]):
        loadings[fid] = effect_size
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
